subject: mathematics
title: Add-Up Adventure · Q2 W04 D01
objective: Add numbers with sums up to 10,000, with or without regrouping.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Add from ones to thousands. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten, 10 tens as 1 hundred, and so on. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: a number that is added to another number
to trade 10 ones for 1 ten (or 10 tens for 1 hundred)

activities.instruction: Listen to Milo. He will show you how to add from ones to thousands.
activities.content: Add from ones to thousands. five hundred seventy three plus two hundred forty eight equals eight hundred twenty one. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten when needed.
